title: SIEM Alert: Unauthorized Script Execution on MCHD-INT01

fields.rule: Unapproved scheduled task re-ran after restore on MCHD-INT01
fields.ruleDescription: After the restore from the 10-20 backup image, a scheduled task ran /opt/iisexport/auto_cleaner.py as svc-iisexport. The script is not in the approved software list (MCHD-FAC-SYS-2026, rev 2.0) and has no signature.
fields.rawEvent: 2026-10-22T09:45:12-05:00 MCHD-INT01 Sentinel Point SIEM 1000000: Suspicious script execution detected. Process 'python /opt/iisexport/auto_cleaner.py' executed from 'svc-iisexport@marstonhealth.example' on host 'MCHD-INT01' (10.72.14.22). Script not in approved software list (MCHD-FAC-SYS-2026, rev 2.0). No digital signature found. Payload: base64-encoded script, likely to alter IIS export file.

instructorNote: This is a critical evidence inject confirming the attacker's use of a malicious script. IT must immediately validate the script's absence from the approved software list and escalate to the Incident Commander and County Information Security Officer per C2 and C11.
